title: Run Business Central Cloud Migration Setup

facts.text: Person setting up cloud migration must be signed in as administrator of Microsoft Entra tenant and Business Central online.
Run assisted setup from company not being migrated; setup prevents selecting current company for migration.
Other users must be signed out of target companies before replication starts.
Delegated administrators need approval from licensed user with Essentials or Premium license and SUPER permission set to run setup.
Open Cloud Migration Setup, read information and consent by switching on acceptance, select product version matching on-premises source.
Fill SQL database connection info on Define Your SQL Database Connection page, select Next to create pipeline in Azure.
Select one or more companies to migrate or enable Migrate All Companies option, then select Next.
Rerunning setup allows adding more companies or changing companies via Cloud Migration Management Select Companies to Migrate action.
